name: Tsukumo Onna Aoe
source:
Beings like yokai, demons, and ghosts aren’t just myths—they’re real. Those who prey on humans are called “Ayakashi,” and it’s the job of exorcists to protect people from their threat.

The protagonist, Moritsugu, is one such exorcist. Still only half-fledged, he works alongside his childhood friend and senior exorcist, Aifumi.

One day, Ayakashi surge in number across Suoku City. Aifumi asks Moritsugu to investigate. Fired up to prove himself and be recognized as a full-fledged exorcist, he’s given something by Aifumi: a spirit blade—a weapon for cutting down Ayakashi, inhabited by a Tsukumogami. “Its name is Aoe,” she says. “From today, it’s your partner.”

Prompted, he draws the spirit blade, and with a soft glow the Tsukumogami reveals herself. A partner who will fight by his side. A companion to whom he’ll entrust his life. The very first thing “she” says is:
“I’m not going to work.”

Undaunted by her brazen NEET declaration, Moritsugu sets out on the mission with the closed-off Aoe. Will Aoe ever open her heart to him? And what truth will emerge at the end of their investigation—?

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/comet/aoe/index.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
妖怪、恶魔和幽灵并非神话，而是真实存在。以人类为食的存在被称为“妖”，驱魔师负责保护人们免受它们威胁。

主角守继就是驱魔师之一。尚未完全成熟的他，与青梅竹马兼前辈驱魔师爱文一起工作。

一天，苏奥克市的妖数量激增。爱文请守继调查。为了证明自己、成为正式驱魔师，爱文交给他一把灵刀——能够斩杀妖、寄宿着付丧神的武器。“它叫青江，”她说，“从今天起就是你的搭档。”

在她催促下，守继拔出灵刀，付丧神在柔和光芒中现身。她将与他并肩作战，是他托付生命的伙伴。她说的第一句话却是：
“我不工作。”

守继没有被她厚颜无耻的家里蹲宣言吓退，与封闭内心的青江一同出发执行任务。青江会向他敞开心扉吗？调查的尽头又会揭示怎样的真相——？

[译自[url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/comet/aoe/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
